couplets.en: There is a reason you lose yourself, Ghalib.

lines: Kuchh to hai jis ki pardadari hai
couplets.en: Something is being kept behind the veil.
There is a reason you lose yourself, Ghalib.
There was a suit between my heart and those lashes.

lines: Aaj phir us ki rubakari hai
couplets.en: Today the case comes before the court again.
There is a reason you lose yourself.

lines: Aaj phir us ki rubakari hai
couplets.en: Today the case comes before the court again.
There is a reason you lose yourself, Ghalib.

lines: Phir usi bewafa pe marte hain
couplets.en: Once more I would die for that same faithless love.
Once more I am living that same life.
There is a reason you lose yourself, Ghalib.

lines: Kuchh to hai jis ki pardadari hai
couplets.en: Something is being kept behind the veil.
There is a reason you lose yourself, Ghalib.
A piece of my wounded heart petitions the court again.
It is a plea made of sighs and lament.
There is a reason you lose yourself, Ghalib.
The court has ordered that tears be shed.
There is a reason you lose yourself, Ghalib.

lines: Phir kuchh ik dil ko beqarari hai
couplets.en: There is a little restlessness in my heart again.
My breast longs for a wound that will strike deep.
There is a reason you lose yourself, Ghalib.
